the anti-Mullerian hormone (AMH) concentration on any day of a woman’s cycle is a reliable predictor of her ovarian response during assisted reproductive technology (ART) treatment and is a good indicator of the probability of a live birth.

the anti-Müllerian (AMH) hormone measurement on day 3 of the cycle (AMH3) and the measurement of antral follicle count (AFC) are the best predictors of ovarian reserve in women undergoing assisted reproductive technology (ART).
